title: Bind four Spring startup controls to their original classes
description: On both original binder graphs prove all 161 archived resource bytes through the application loader and reject a changed final byte. On the historical fluent graph qualify the active branch of the earlier 32 native proofs on two exact JVM launches, check both original observers return zero or one, and keep the unmatched launch separate. On both original property-name JARs check all twelve selectors individually from ordinary startup including separate original-JVM replay of every parent component violation. Observe the converter factory submitted first by each formatter graph, verify both generic interfaces and both resolved types, and let the original registration return.
expected: Two strict factory-stream proofs, two bound fluent launches with the negative control, and nine verified metadata selectors plus three replayed parent violations. Both formatter JVMs must register the observed Number-to-Number factory.

steps.name: Factory resource bytes and one-bit control
Discharge the fluent guard on the measured launches
Every metadata name from ordinary startup
First converter factory and its generic interfaces
